source.title: GB 13000.1字符集汉字笔顺规范
source.method: verified artifact recovery -> render complete 8-page original scan -> visual overview of all pages -> high-resolution visual review of exact target rows on PDF pages 7-8; table is explicitly abridged after sequence 134

limits: Only exact rows actually visible in the GF3002 public PDF are upgraded.
The public PDF prints table sequences 1-134 then marks the remainder as omitted; it is not treated as a complete 20,902-row table.
This evidence does not close fine_stroke_names, pronunciation, component naming, GF0011—2022 identity, position migration, artwork, PDF or release status.
